answer: Rotating beacon assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random function assigns identities to shards; assignment slots are published only after registration closes, so the marble of each epoch's map is unpredictable in advance. An agent must occupy a slot on a knoll of verified work history—a logged sequence of accepted tasks—to receive assignments. Sybils must fabricate that history before each epoch, and because slots rotate, a walnut of accumulated fake history loses value each round.
